headwords: mỗi cây mỗi hoa, mỗi nhà mỗi cảnh

flags.why: Calling someone mỏ nhọn is derogatory, describing someone who likes verbal disputes ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/m%E1%BB%8F_nh%E1%BB%8Dn)).
The fontanelle sense is Southern regional usage and needs that warning ([linguistics source](https://nguvan.hnue.edu.vn/Nghi%C3%AAn-c%E1%BB%A9u/Ng%C3%B4n-ng%E1%BB%AF/p/1813)).
